bio: I’m so excited to meet you! My name is Jennet, and I’m a third-year PhD student in the George Church Lab. My research focuses on developing new RNA diagnostic techniques for neurodegenerative disorders, which are becoming increasingly prevalent as our population ages. I’m originally from Ashgabat, Turkmenistan, and have been living in the United States for the past eight years. I love exploring New England, baking, and collecting antiques from Turkmenistan. Please feel free to reach out with any questions—I’m thrilled to be your proctor in Crimson Yard! Community Yards Elm Yard Area Proctors Role Proctors
